summary.text: Eric Zehr is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 51, which covers parts of Bedford, Campbell and Pittsylvania counties.
Eric Zehr has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Eric Zehr was born in Lowville, New York, in 1971.
Eric Zehr studied at Liberty University (B.A., Psychology, 1995) and Liberty University (M.A., Counseling, 1997).
Eric Zehr's listed occupation is self-employed contractor.
The profile lists Jodi M. Zehr as Eric Zehr's spouse.
The House profile lists Eric Zehr's committee assignments as Public Safety and Education.
